description: This file defines a Spring configuration class AuditorAwareConfig that implements AuditorAware<String>. It provides a method to retrieve the current auditor's identifier, defaulting to 'SYSTEM_USER' if no authentication ID is available from the ApiRequestContextHolder.

classes.name: AuditorAwareConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class implementing AuditorAware to provide current auditor information for auditing purposes.

methods.name: getCurrentAuditor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the current auditor's ID, or 'SYSTEM_USER' if none is found.
